# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger hash seed generation**

## Highlights

The shared hash-code implementation now seeds its per-process randomization from the operating system's cryptographic random generator.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Cryptographic hash seeding** — The HashCode polyfill shared by SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp replaces System.Random with RandomNumberGenerator. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes the cryptography dependency. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
